mcphone_deepseek.app.deepseek.desc: Chat with DeepSeek from your phone. Streaming replies, reasoning and Markdown, using your own API key.
mcphone_deepseek.ui.greeting: Hi, I'm DeepSeek. Nice to meet you!
mcphone_deepseek.ui.greeting_sub: I can write code, read files and draft all kinds of content. Just hand me the task.
mcphone_deepseek.ui.no_key_sub: Add your own key to start chatting
mcphone_deepseek.settings.clear_confirm: Tap again -- this cannot be undone
mcphone_deepseek.settings.privacy: Your key and chats stay on this computer. Requests go straight from your client to the address above; the server is not involved and cannot see them.
mcphone_deepseek.error.no_key: No API key yet. Add one in settings first.
mcphone_deepseek.error.bad_url: That base URL is not valid: %s
mcphone_deepseek.error.auth: API key is wrong or no longer valid.
mcphone_deepseek.error.balance: Not enough balance. Top up your DeepSeek account and try again.
mcphone_deepseek.error.not_found: No API at that address. Check the base URL -- other providers usually need /v1 on the end.
mcphone_deepseek.error.rate_limit: Too many requests. Give it a moment.
mcphone_deepseek.error.server_busy: The service is busy. Try again shortly.
mcphone_deepseek.error.dns: Host not found. Check your network and the base URL: %s
mcphone_deepseek.error.tls: TLS handshake failed -- usually a proxy or a wrong system clock: %s
mcphone_deepseek.error.unknown: Something went wrong, but it is not clear what.
